name: MongoDB - Old
description: The Sumo Logic App for MongoDB provides insight into your MongoDB environment, allowing you to track overall system health, queries, logins and connections, errors and warnings, replication, and sharding.

panels.name: Stopped Servers
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB  ("dbexit" or  ( "] waiting for connections on port") or "transition to")
| if (_raw matches "*dbexit*", "Down",if (_raw matches "*transition to*", "Up" ,if (_raw matches "*] waiting for connections on port*", "Up", "UnKnown")))  as server_status 
| timeslice 100s
| _sourceHost as Host
| withtime server_status | withtime _messagetime
| most_recent(server_status_withtime) as server_status, most_recent(_messagetime_withtime) as m_time by Host
| formatDate(fromMillis(m_time), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS", "UTC") as event_time
| ((toMillis(now())-m_time)/(1000*60)) as since_mins | format("%.2f", since_mins) as since_minutes
| concat ("Since ", since_minutes, " minutes") as Remark
| where !(server_status="Up")
| fields - m_time, since_mins, since_minutes 
| fields Host, event_time, server_status, remark

panels.name: Up Servers
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB  ("dbexit" or  ( "] waiting for connections on port") or "transition to")
| if (_raw matches "*dbexit*", "Down",if (_raw matches "*transition to*", "Up" ,if (_raw matches "*] waiting for connections on port*", "Up", "UnKnown")))  as server_status 
| _sourceHost as Host
| timeslice 100s
| withtime server_status | withtime _messagetime
| most_recent(server_status_withtime) as server_status, most_recent(_messagetime_withtime) as m_time by Host
| formatDate(fromMillis(m_time), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS", "UTC") as event_time
| ((toMillis(now())-m_time)/(1000*60)) as since_mins | format("%.2f", since_mins) as since_minutes
| concat ("Since ", since_minutes, " minutes") as Remark
| where server_status = "Up"
| fields - m_time, since_mins, since_minutes 
| fields Host, event_time, server_status, remark

panels.name: Slowest Execution Time (in MS) of  DB  Commands
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB
| parse "* * * [*] *" as timestamp,severity,component,context,msg 
| where component matches "*COMMAND*"
| parse regex field=msg "command [\w\.\$]+ command: (?<db_cmd>[\w]+ )\{.+ (?<dur>[0-9]+)ms"
| max( dur) as max_duration group by db_cmd

panels.name: Primary Node
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB and REPL and ( "is now in state" or "Couldn't get a connection within the time limit")
| parse "* * * [*] *" as timestamp,severity,component,context,msg 
| where component matches "*REPL*"
| parse regex field=msg "Member (?<host_name>[\S]+:[0-9]+) is now" nodrop
| parse regex field=msg "Error in heartbeat request to (?<host_name>[\S]+:[\d]+); ExceededTimeLimit:? Couldn't get a connection within the time limit"
| withtime msg 
|most_recent(msg_withtime) as message by  host_name
| parse regex field=message "Member [\S]+:[0-9]+ is now in state (?<state>[A-Z]+)"
| where state ="PRIMARY"
| fields host_name, message ,state
